summary: The V4 metadata sync notes for 29 June 2026 list an agenda with some design detail but no stated decisions. The items were finalizing partition-based pruning, using Anoop's document on aggregation rules and Amogh's document on a unified field id for expressions; an exact flag for null count and NaN count in stats; and the observation that a data DV update still has to scan the old manifest to fetch the old entry even with manifest DVs, with API ideas for carrying content stats from scan planning through to commit.

topics.title: Finalizing partition-based pruning
topics.summary: The agenda item was to finalize partition-based pruning. Two documents fed into it: Anoop's document, which discusses the aggregation rules, and Amogh's document, which discusses a unified field id for expressions. The notes record no conclusion.

topics.title: Stats: exact flag for null count and NaN count
topics.summary: Agenda item on an exact flag for the null count and NaN count statistics. The notes give no detail and record no outcome.

topics.title: Avoiding the old-manifest scan on data DV updates
topics.summary: Even with a manifest DV, a data DV update still needs to scan the old manifest file to fetch the old entry (for example its content_stats) in order to produce the new manifest entry. If the client carried content_stats from scan planning to commit, that overhead could potentially be avoided. The notes observe that FileScanTask contains DataFile, DeleteFile and List<ColumnFile>, and list API ideas: a new add(TrackedFile) with TrackedFile exposed as a public interface, or expanding DeleteFile with DataFile colocatedDataFile() plus List<ColumnFile> columnFiles(), since the former alone would not cover column files.
